notes: New 3D graphics made in Blender: gold stopwatch, gold logo, clipboard and coins
Splash screen has the 3D logo and a swinging stopwatch
Confetti and a cheer when you log a day
Greeting and a pay-period countdown bar on the Today screen
Enter Total hours worked for the day; Regular and Extra hours are filled in automatically
Anything over the 3:48 shift goes to Extra hours
Splash screen title is level and both lines are the same width
Time can be entered to the minute (1-minute steps); hold + or − to speed up
Clock times count every minute; anything over the 3.8-hour (3:48) shift still goes to Extra hours
Removed Uniform hourly and Sick/Holiday from the day screen, timesheet, print and CSV
Shift is 3.8 hours (3:48); anything over it goes to Extra hours automatically
Start/End times use digital hour : minute AM/PM pickers instead of the round clock
Timesheet fits the phone screen: each day's explanation shows on its own line under that day
Time now moves in 6-minute steps (0.1 hour) instead of 10 minutes
Shift length can be set to tenths of an hour, e.g. 3 hr 48 min = 3.8 hours
Clock-in/out times round to the nearest 6 minutes
A shift length saved in 10-minute steps is moved to the nearest 6 minutes
First release of Stacy's Time Tracker
Opens on today's date from the phone's calendar
Shift length set once in Profile; time over the shift goes to Extra hours (1.5x or 2.0x)
All time in 10-minute increments
Pay-period timesheet (19th to 18th) with totals, Hours x Rate, print/PDF and CSV
Settings > Updates: checks for new versions on startup
